backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining data types (Exercise, BlogPost, AmazonProduct, Membership, MuscleGroupDetails, UserProfile, StripeConfig) and CRUD operations with access control, blob storage, Stripe integration, and migration support; includes membership price field set to 2499 cents ($24.99).
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms old Membership records (without price field) to new Membership records by adding a default price of 2499 cents ($24.99) during canister upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the membership price update from $19.99 to $24.99 in the StartMembershipCheckoutButton component with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including pages, components, hooks, and configuration; notes that useQueries.ts sets membership price to $24.99 (2499 cents) and describes the full application structure.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide explaining how to deploy to Internet Computer, retrieve the live .icp0.io URL, distinguish between preview and deployed URLs, and access the in-app Domain Setup page for custom domain configuration.
frontend/DOMAIN_SETUP.md: Custom domain setup guide for connecting cerebralphysique.com to the Internet Computer deployment via GoDaddy (www-only with forwarding) or Cloudflare (apex + www) DNS configuration, with instructions to retrieve canister ID from the in-app /domain-setup page.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with base layer defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes using OKLCH color space, including color tokens for UI components (background, foreground, primary, secondary, accent, destructive, borders, charts, sidebar).
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script loading main.tsx; sets page title to 'Cerebral Physique LLC Company Website'.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for all pages (home, about, workout library, programs, blog, contact, dashboards, store, payment, domain setup), ThemeProvider set to dark mode, and Toaster for notifications.
frontend/src/components/CopyToClipboardC: A reusable button component that copies text to clipboard with visual feedback (icon toggle and toast notification), supporting both modern and fallback clipboard APIs.
frontend/src/components/creator/Affiliat: Admin interface for managing Amazon affiliate products with CRUD operations, form validation, and table display of products with categories and affiliate links.
frontend/src/components/creator/BlogMana: Admin dashboard for manually creating, editing, publishing, and deleting blog posts with SEO fields, member-only flags, and content validation.
frontend/src/components/creator/Breathwo: Empty component file for breathwork management functionality (not yet implemented).
frontend/src/components/creator/Exercise: Admin interface for managing exercises with CRUD operations, muscle group/equipment type selection, video/image URLs, movement cues, and placeholder flags.
frontend/src/components/creator/MuscleGr: React component for managing muscle group cards with edit dialogs, allowing creators to update titles, descriptions, and image URLs for predefined muscle groups (Chest, Back, Shoulders, etc.).
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying brand logo, quick navigation links, social media icons, and copyright information with a "Made with Heart" message.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Main navigation header with centered logo, responsive menu (desktop/mobile), music player toggle, authentication controls, and conditional admin dashboard link.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that wraps pages with Header, main content area (Outlet), and Footer in a flex column structure.
frontend/src/components/membership/Start: Button component that initiates a Stripe checkout session for a $24.99/month membership with loading state and error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using Internet Identity, initializing access control with an admin token and invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useMusicPlayer.tsx: Zustand store and hook for managing global music player state including play/pause, volume, mute status, and audio element reference with localStorage persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating exercises, blog posts, muscle groups, memberships, user profiles, shopping items, and Stripe-related data from the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom dark theme using black, deep blue, medium gray, and neon purple colors, plus custom utility classes and scrollbar styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Displays the About page with hero section, founder story for Stefan Philip Sweeting, and mission/values cards highlighting the Cerebral Physique training philosophy.
frontend/src/pages/AffiliateStorePage.ts: Shows a curated list of Amazon affiliate products with categories, images, and purchase links, including an affiliate disclosure alert.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPage.tsx: Displays blog post previews in a grid, with member-only badges and admin management button; filters content based on membership status.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPostPage.tsx: Renders individual blog post content with membership gating; shows preview for locked posts and prompts non-members to subscribe.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Provides contact information (support and general inquiry emails) and quick navigation links to other platform sections like programs and workout library.
Admin-only dashboard page with tabs for managing exercises, muscle groups, blog posts, and affiliate store items. Includes access control check and loading states.
frontend/src/pages/DomainSetupPage.tsx: Instructional page for connecting a custom domain (cerebralphysique.com) to an Internet Computer deployment, displaying canister ID, DNS setup instructions, and copy-to-clipboard controls.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero section, feature cards, and auto-playing background music with user prompt for enabling audio if autoplay is blocked by browser.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Simple error page displayed when payment processing fails, offering retry and contact support options.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Payment confirmation page that verifies Stripe session status, invalidates membership queries on success, and redirects users to dashboard or workout library.
frontend/src/pages/ProgramsPage.tsx: Marketing page showcasing fitness programs with hero section, featured 7-day challenge card, and animated background images for visual appeal.
frontend/src/pages/UserDashboardPage.tsx: User dashboard page that displays membership status, handles authentication via Internet Identity, and includes a profile setup dialog for new users to enter their name.
frontend/src/pages/WorkoutLibraryPage.ts: Workout library page that displays exercises organized by muscle groups in collapsible sections, with membership-gated access and default fallback images for each muscle group.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, container settings, animations, and typography/container-queries plugins.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file indicating pending feature requests to update membership pricing from $19.99 to $24.99 in both frontend and backend components.
